name: Dennis M. McClelland
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Tampa, Florida

about: Dennis M. McClelland is an attorney who represents clients in the Tampa, Florida area. Dennis McClelland is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dennis McClelland chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated in 1996. Dennis McClelland passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
He represents clients with Employment Litigation: Defense issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employer issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dennis McClelland has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
